title: social-share-link
description: a link to share content on social

attributes.name: dark
attributes.description: render in dark mode; forwarded to the icon. issues#3102 DDD: this was undeclared, which made the ?dark render binding dead and left the element unable to respond to dark mode.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: true when there is nothing to share (no usable href). Reflected onto the host so the :host([disabled]) styling is reachable (issues#3102 #21).

attributes.name: image
attributes.description: optional image to attach to the share (Pinterest only)

attributes.name: message
attributes.description: the message to attach to the social share (not used in Facebook)

attributes.name: mode
attributes.description: optional display mode for the link,"text-only" or "icon-only"; default is to dislay both an icon and text

attributes.name: text
attributes.description: the link text; if null, the text will be "Share on (type of social)"

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: the type of social; currently supports Facebook, LinkedIn, Pinterest, and Twitter (default)
